a2-unit-06.06.1 Conversations:
Narrator: Conversation one.
Paulo: Hi Maya, do you have a minute? I read the reviews of your Brooklyn food tour. Well done! Twenty five-star reviews this month!
Maya: Oh, you're too kind. It was a team effort.
Paulo: Maybe, but I know you're really good at talking to tourists. Keep up the good work!
Maya: I'll take that, thanks!
Narrator: Conversation two.
Paulo: Good morning! Congratulations on the new baby! What a cute little girl!
Neighbor: Thank you! Her name is Olivia.
Paulo: How's she sleeping? I never hear her at night.
Neighbor: Not too bad, actually.
Paulo: Glad to hear it. Good luck!
Narrator: Conversation three.
Paulo: Hey, I saw your photos. You ran the Chicago Marathon! Congratulations!
Tom: Thanks! It was really hard, but I finished in four hours and twenty minutes.
Paulo: Wow, good job! I really like the T-shirt with your time on it.
Tom: I'm glad you like it! Next year, the New York City Marathon. Are you in?
Paulo: Me? I get tired on the subway stairs!
Narrator: Conversation four.
Carol: Hi Paulo! Can you see me?
Paulo: Hi! Yes, I can. Wow, you look great today!
Carol: You too!
Paulo: That dress really suits you. Where did you get it?
Carol: Actually, my boss gave it to me for my birthday.
Paulo: Your boss? What a nice boss! Say hi to her for me.
